summary.result: By employing FE dominant method in which boundary stiffness matrix is transformed into finite element stiffness matrix, boundary element and finite element method are combined to analyze frame structure with walls.

summary.method: This model analyzes the frame by employing the finite element method and the shear wall by boundary element method.
